dedication:
Rachel,

You grew up on nine acres in Selleck with Highland cows, chickens, and homemade fruit wine. I can't give you the farm back (yet), so I built you this one.

Clear the brambles, name the cows, and put a hat on every single one of them.

I love you.

Your husband

easterEggs.text: Fergus approves of this statue. Fergus approves of very few things.
Luna has accepted you as her human. This is the highest honor available.

familyWine.description: The family recipe, the way it was always made. Some things you don't change.
